name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should adopt the 2px #005fcc focus ring with a 1px #fff inset at 70% opacity for EXCAVA. This decision provides a clear visual indicator for keyboard navigation, meeting the WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements, and is visually appealing. By choosing this option, we're accepting a trade-off of slightly thicker focus rings on some elements, which may affect their overall design aesthetic. This compromise is worth it, as it ensures that all users, including those with visual impairments, can effectively navigate the platform using their keyboards.

name: Reader
text: The 2px #005fcc ring with 1px #fff inset fails WCAG 2.2 AA on dark backgrounds (#000 or #111) where contrast drops below 4.5:1. Use a 3px solid #005fcc ring instead—it meets AA on both light and dark modes without blending. Test it in both themes with Playwright MCP’s accessibility checks to settle it.
